title: Build a ModelForm for Blog Posts
description: Create a ModelForm for a Post model and implement a view to create new posts.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Assume you have a `Post` model with fields `title`, `content`, and `author` (ForeignKey to User). Create a ModelForm that allows users to create new posts.

- The form should include only `title` and `content` (author will be set automatically from the logged‑in user).
- In the view, if the form is valid, create a new post with the current user as author and redirect to the post detail page.
- Use the `{% url %}` tag to generate the success URL.
- Ensure that only authenticated users can access the form (use `@login_required` decorator).

Write the ModelForm, view, and template.
hints: Define `PostForm` with `class Meta: model = Post; fields = ['title', 'content']`.
In the view, after `form.is_valid()`, call `form.save(commit=False)`, assign `post.author = request.user`, then `post.save()`.
Redirect to a named URL (e.g., `post_detail` with the post's id).
expectedOutput: Logged‑in users can visit `/create/` to see the form. Submitting valid data creates a new post and redirects to its detail page.
